Custom Filters Endpoint
/api/partner/1.0/{product}/customReturnManagerFilters/{year} (GET)
Endpoint authentication
When adopting OAuth 2.0 as an authentication method, the below security requirements are needed in order to trigger this endpoint:
The user must fulfill the below security roles requirements; if he fails to obtain access to all the necessary security roles, an error 403: Insufficient privileges to execute this request is returned:
The user must acquire access to at least one of the following security roles; he needs to have access to the security role corresponding to the product included in the URL:
Tax â Access T1 Product
Tax â Access T2 Product
Tax â Access T3 Product
Tax â Access Forms Product
Endpoint description
Retrieves the list of all the Return Managerâs custom filters, custom diagnostics and filters that are available for a given product and year. Invalid filters which contain errors and filters created on the current day will not be returned in the API response. The product (T1, T2, T3 or TF) and year must be provided in the URL.
